K01.drivers: Typical adult proportions, average build, normal chest/abdomen profile, straight legs

K02.drivers: Average slim-normal build, ordinary segment ratios

K03.drivers: Slightly softer abdomen and deeper trunk in profile, otherwise ordinary

K04.drivers: Profile shows a deep keel-like ribcage bulging both front and back with abrupt narrowing to a pinched waist; very thin long limbs with knobby knee bulges; narrow pelvis; shape not matching normal thin-human chest-waist transition
axial_cues: barrel/keel chest bulging front and back in profile

K05.drivers: Same pattern as K04: deep rounded thorax in profile, slender limbs, pronounced knee/shin contour, narrow hips
limb_cues: bulging knee/upper shin contour in profile

K07.drivers: Massive trunk with very wide shoulders, huge bulbous forearms and hands hanging at knee level, enormous thighs, thick lumpy calves, very large broad feet; profile shows knees bent and leg zigzag; segment relations (limb mass vs trunk, foot size) beyond human range

K08.drivers: Somewhat broader trunk and soft belly/buttocks in profile, still ordinary human proportions

K09.drivers: Same body plan as K07, even more extreme: gorilla-like arm mass, enormous thighs, crouched bent-knee profile with forward lean, huge feet

K11.drivers: Ordinary average build, slightly broader shoulders

groups.label: massive troll/ogre-like, huge limbs and feet, bent-knee stance

distinguishing_features: K07/K09 are defined by enormous mass in arms, thighs and feet, irregular bulging joints and a crouched bent-knee profile. K04/K05 are slender with near-human limb lengths but a deep rounded or keeled thorax that bulges front and back in profile, a sharp waist pinch, narrow pelvis and knobby knees. They are opposite in bulk and differ in trunk organization. The K04/K05 call is less certain because they could be read as very thin humans with an odd chest profile.
